title: Dynamic dashboard failure modes and tenant metrics instrumentation
creator: Rina Patel
description: Summary: During a capacity spike on 2026-03-08 we observed a prolonged degradation of Console insights for a small subset of enterprise customers. Root cause analysis showed three blind spots: 1) several critical SLO KPIs (95th/99th tail latency by tenant) were not emitted with tenant dimension because a legacy aggregator dropped tenant tags under high cardinality; 2) a dashboard construction pattern (dynamic roll-up panels) masked tenant-level outliers by always showing service-level aggregates; 3) tracing sampling for the KV cache execution path defaulted to 0.1% which omitted traces for the skewed tenants and prevented root-cause triage. As a result, on-call detection relied on noisy service-level alerts and the team missed early signals of tenant-specific throttling that caused customer-visible latency spikes.
acceptance_criteria: All critical latency and error KPIs exposed by the runtime must include tenant_id as a primary dimension or a linked rollup within console dashboards
Create and deploy a resilient dashboard pattern that includes a tenant drilldown widget and a fallback view that signals when tenant cardinality is truncated
Increase KV cache and request-path tracing sampling for targets with detected tail skew; provide feature flag to toggle tracing sampling per-tenant for a 48h alpha window
Add synthetic tenant-level smoke tests that run daily and verify metric emission and dashboard render for top 100 tenants
Add an alert (burn-rate and SLA drift) scoped to tenant tails that trips before service-level aggregate alerts
comments: 2026-03-09 - Initial postmortem: collection gaps at the aggregator layer + dashboard rollup pattern identified. Rina P. assigned to author remediation plan.

2026-03-10 - Engineering triage: Marcos D. will own instrumentation changes. Proposed steps: (A) restore tenant tag preservation in metrics pipeline; (B) add dashboard rendering tests; (C) tweak sampling for traces on the KV path.

2026-03-11 - Design/PM feedback: Add a fallback visual state for dashboards when cardinality is high or tenant groups are missing. PM (Aisha Kline) requested runbook updates for on-call detection of tenant skew.

2026-03-12 - Implementation notes: Prototype change to aggregator completed in feature branch, tests added for tenant tag preservation. Need infra approval for increased trace ingestion quota before enabling sampling change in prod.
2026-03-12 - Blocker: requires console-metrics-infra quota bump (see dependency ENG-43812) and a short config rollout window to avoid noisy spikes. Scheduled deploy window 2026-03-18.

2026-03-12 - Next steps: (1) open infra PR for retention quota; (2) ship dashboard test harness and create failing-case dashboard to exercise alerts; (3) coordinate with SRE to enable tenant-scoped trace sampling for 72h canary for 5 affected tenants.
notes: This ticket focuses on hardening observability for tenant-level regressions discovered during capacity events. Implementation should prioritize low-risk metric fixes and dashboard tests before changing trace sampling in prod. Coordinate with product for customer communications if we observe further tenant regressions during rollout.
